name: Zul'Gurub: Hakkar drains a living High Priest's loa avatar each time he loses another 15% of his health
contract: Tester feedback round 6 (2026-11-13): Hakkar (14834) devoured only one loa avatar; he drains them one at a time,
nearest first, with Drain Power (2118700). Round 7 (2026-11-14): not every avatar at the start, but over the
fight. Live logs (2025-12-21, 2026-08-02, 2026-08-09; seven pulls) tie each avatar's death to his health, not
to the clock: it died once the damage he took, Heart included, reached the same share, 46-149 s into the pull;
the one kill puts each step at 15.0 %. In a fresh Normal instance all five priests live: at full health
50 s into the fight Hakkar has no Aspect and all five avatars (666988-666992) stand (a 45 s timer would have
drained one); at 90 % still none; at 84 % one Aspect; at 80 % still one; at 69 % a second; at 20 % all five
Aspects (2118701-2118705) with every avatar consumed. The last drains run into the end of Blood Siphon
(first cast 59.5 s, 20 s long), which interrupted the drain that had replaced its channel and left Hakkar
with four Aspects. The hero joins phase 1, where the ring appears.
